retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, low-key composition featuring western apparel illuminated by warm directional light against a deep black background with bold sans-serif text.
triggerTerms: cowboy hat and boots dark background
excludeWhen: vintage or distressed textures are needed
serif or script typography is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A central still life of a brown leather cowboy hat resting on a black leather boot, emerging from total darkness via a warm, amber-toned key light from the upper right, paired with clean white geometric sans-serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Hat resting diagonally across the boot shaft
Text anchored to top-left and bottom-right corners
Warm amber highlights contrasting with deep black shadows
Vertical red accent bar adjacent to the bottom-right text
coreInvariants: Low-key lighting with high shadow density

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The hat and boot are centrally located, occupying approximately 60% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The crown of the cowboy hat serves as the primary focal point due to the strongest light reflection.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the bold title in the top left, down the diagonal slope of the hat brim to the boot, ending at the date in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the subject, creating a dramatic, isolated effect.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white text and black background; low saturation in the subject except for warm leather tones.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'M' with a deep central vertex reaching the baseline
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and sizes for consistency.
graphicDevices: Vertical red rectangular bar on the far right edge

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, modern geometric structure and circular counters.
Provides a similar geometric feel with high readability in bold weights.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key photograph of a brown leather cowboy hat resting on a black leather boot. Use a single warm light source from the upper right to create highlights on the leather textures while keeping the rest of the frame in deep black shadow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold white geometric sans-serif text in the top-left corner. Add a four-digit year in the bottom-right corner in the same font style, placed immediately to the left of a thin vertical red bar.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting warm and directional?
Is the text a clean, bold sans-serif?
Is there a red vertical bar in the bottom right?

mustRedesign: Do not use a textured or wooden background
Ensure the red bar is a clean geometric shape
postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast between text and background
Verify the diagonal placement of the hat
Ensure the red bar is perfectly vertical
Confirm the light source feels singular and warm
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key lighting + Western subject + Geometric Sans-Serif + Corner-anchored layout
